metadata:

  namespace: openshift-ptp
spec:
  restartPolicy: Never
  serviceAccountName: builder
  containers:
    - name: priv
      image: quay.io/podman/stable:v4.9.4
      command:
        - /bin/bash
        - -c
        - |
          set -xe
          yum install jq git wget podman-docker -y
          yum group install "development-tools" -y
          wget https://go.dev/dl/go1.20.4.linux-amd64.tar.gz
          rm -rf /usr/local/go && tar -C /usr/local -xzf go1.20.4.linux-amd64.tar.gz
          export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin
          go version

          # set +x here to hide pass from log
          set +xe

          echo "podman login with serviceaccount"

          # Used for 4.16 and newer releases.
          pass=$( jq .\"image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000\".auth /var/run/secrets/openshift.io/push/.dockercfg )
          pass=`echo ${pass:1:-1} | base64 -d`
          podman login -u serviceaccount -p ${pass:8} image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 --tls-verify=false

          # Used for 4.15 and older releases.
          if ! podman login --get-login image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 &> /dev/null; then
            pass=$( jq .\"image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000\".password /var/run/secrets/openshift.io/push/.dockercfg )
            podman login -u serviceaccount -p ${pass:1:-1} image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 --tls-verify=false
          fi

          set -x

          export IMG=PTP_IMAGE
          export DAEMON_IMG="DAEMON_IMAGE"
          export SIDECAR_IMG="SIDECAR_IMAGE"

          export T5CI_VERSION="T5CI_VERSION_VAL"
          export USE_UPSTREAM="USE_UPSTREAM_VAL"

          # run latest release on upstream main branch
          if [[ "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
            echo "Running on upstream main branch"
            git clone --single-branch --branch main https://github.com/k8snetworkplumbingwg/ptp-operator.git
          else
            git clone --single-branch --branch OPERATOR_VERSION https://github.com/openshift/ptp-operator.git
          fi
          cd ptp-operator
          # OCPBUGS-52327 fix build due to libresolv.so link error
          sed -i "s/\(CGO_ENABLED=\${CGO_ENABLED}\) \(GOOS=\${GOOS}\)/\1 CC=\"gcc -fuse-ld=gold\" \2/" hack/build.sh
          # For UPSTREAM use Dockerfile for upstream contents
          if [[ "$T5CI_VERSION" =~ 4.1[2-8]+ || "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
            sed -i "/ENV GO111MODULE=off/ a\ENV GOMAXPROCS=20" Dockerfile
            make docker-build
          else
            # Dockerfile is updated to upstream in 4.19+. Use .ocp or .ci versions for non-UPSTREAM runs
            if [ -f "Dockerfile.ocp" ]; then
              DOCKERFILE="Dockerfile.ocp"
            else
              DOCKERFILE="Dockerfile.ci"
            fi
            sed -i "/ENV GO111MODULE=off/ a\ENV GOMAXPROCS=20" "$DOCKERFILE"
            podman build -t "${IMG}" -f "$DOCKERFILE"
          fi
          podman push ${IMG} --tls-verify=false
          cd ..

          if [[ "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "false" ]]; then
            # If we a running a downstream run we are done
            exit 0
          fi

          # If were running upstream we should also use the upstream daemon!
          echo "Running on upstream main branch of linuxptp-daemon"
          git clone --single-branch --branch main https://github.com/k8snetworkplumbingwg/linuxptp-daemon.git
          cd linuxptp-daemon
          # Split DAEMON_IMG into IMAGE_TAG_BASE and VERSION because
          # hack/build-image.sh unconditionally overwrites IMG from these two vars.
          IMAGE_TAG_BASE="${DAEMON_IMG%:*}" VERSION="${DAEMON_IMG##*:}" make image
          podman push ${DAEMON_IMG} --tls-verify=false
          cd ..

          echo "Running on main branch of cloud-event-proxy"
          git clone --single-branch --branch main https://github.com/redhat-cne/cloud-event-proxy.git
          cd cloud-event-proxy
          IMG=${SIDECAR_IMG} make podman-build
          podman push ${SIDECAR_IMG} --tls-verify=false
          cd ..

      securityContext:
        privileged: true
      volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /var/run/secrets/openshift.io/push
          name: dockercfg
          readOnly: true
        - name: secret-volume
          mountPath: /root/.docker
  volumes:
    - name: secret-volume
      secret:
        secretName: pull-secret
        items:
        - key: .dockerconfigjson
          path: config.json

    - name: dockercfg
      secret:
        secretName: BUILDER_DOCKERCFG
        defaultMode: 384

issues.ai_summary:
---

**TL;DR:** Transient T-GM GNSS instability on cnfdf32 caused 17 of 18 failures; 1 is a deterministic WPC NIC lab misconfiguration.

**Overall Issue Class:** infra_other
**Overall Severity:** MEDIUM

## Root Causes (18 failures across 7 suites)

### 15/18 failures — Slave ptp4l lock timeout after daemon restart
- **Suites:** bc, dualfollower, dualnicbc, dualnicbcha, oc | **Evidence:** PROVEN (uniform ~200–260 s timeout; `interfaces receiving PTP frames: []` across all 5 suites)
- **What:** After `RestartPTPDaemon()`, slaves never logged "selected best master clock" within the 3-min `Eventually` (`ptptesthelper.go:71`); no upstream PTP frames seen at suite start in any affected suite.
- **Breaking change:** Unknown
- **Flake?** yes
- **Fix:** Retry the job; if recurs, audit GNSS/ts2phc lock on cnfdf32 before daemon-restart steps.

### 3/18 failures — T-GM not in LOCKED state at TGM suite start
- **Suites:** tgm | **Evidence:** PROVEN (T-GM recovered mid-run: bc-serial ClockClass-6 test passed at 04:08 same job)
- **What:** All 3 TGM tests timeout at `checkClockClassState(ClockClass6, 5min)` precondition (`ptp.go:2659, 2706, 2818`); cnfdf32 had transient GNSS loss when the TGM suite executed.
- **Breaking change:** Unknown
- **Flake?** yes
- **Fix:** Retry; add a pre-suite T-GM stability gate that waits for ClockClass 6 before launching TGM tests.

### 1/18 failure — TBC topology: no WPC NIC solution found
- **Suites:** tbc | **Evidence:** PROVEN (`graphsolver.go:73`: "Solution for TBCWithSlavesExtGM does not exist"; deterministic across retries)
- **What:** `PtpConfigTelcoBC()` `BeforeEach` finds zero ports satisfying the ≥3 co-PHC WPC NIC constraint (`testconfig.go:1899`); all downstream tbc tests skip as `discoveryFailure`.
- **Breaking change:** Candidate (unverified): [ptp-operator#205](https://github.com/openshift/ptp-operator/pull/205) introduced the tbc suite on `main` without WPC hardware validation.
- **Flake?** no — deterministic lab configuration mismatch
- **Fix:** Add a WPC NIC capability-check skip guard in tbc `BeforeEach`, or provision WPC-capable lab nodes.

## Summary Table

| # | Test | Suite | Group | Classification | Confidence | Root Cause (one line) | Fix |
|---|------|-------|-------|---------------|------------|----------------------|-----|
| 1 | Slave can sync to master | bc | 1 | infra_timeout | medium | ptp4l never locked after daemon restart | Retry |
| 2 | Downstream slave can sync to BC master | bc | 1 | infra_timeout | medium | ptp4l never locked after daemon restart | Retry |
| 3 | Can provide a profile with higher priority | bc | 1 | infra_timeout | medium | ptp4l never locked after daemon restart | Retry |
| 4–6 | (same 3 tests) | dualfollower | 1 | infra_timeout | medium | MetricClockStateLocked never achieved | Retry |
| 7–9 | (same 3 tests) | dualnicbc | 1 | infra_timeout | medium | ptp4l slave never locked | Retry |
| 10–12 | (same 3 tests) | dualnicbcha | 1 | infra_timeout | medium | PTP never LOCKED | Retry |
| 13–14 | Slave / Higher priority | oc | 1 | test_flake | medium | ptp4l log timeout (0 PTP frames received) | Retry |
| 15–17 | WPC holdover, ts2phc FREERUN, GNSS reboot | tgm | 2 | infra_other | medium | T-GM not LOCKED at suite start | Retry |
| 18 | Slave rebooted and discovered in sync | tbc | 3 | infra_other | high | No WPC NIC topology found in lab | Provision or skip guard |

## Action Items
1. **Retry the job** — 17/18 failures are transient infra; a clean retry will confirm or deny recurrence.
2. **Audit cnfdf32 GNSS stability** — add a pre-suite T-GM ClockClass-6 stability gate to prevent cascading downstream suite failures.
3. **Fix tbc `BeforeEach`** — add a capability-check skip guard so the suite skips cleanly instead of failing when no WPC NIC topology is available.

## Open Questions
1. **Classification contradiction:** oc suite labels Group 1 failures `test_flake`; bc, dualfollower, dualnicbc, dualnicbcha label identical failures `infra_timeout`. The `infra_timeout` label is better supported — the `interfaces receiving PTP frames: []` evidence is hardware, not a test-code race. No override applied; both labels are retained in the table.
2. **Unverified cascade (hypothesis):** Group 2 (T-GM GNSS instability) is the plausible upstream cause of Group 1 (slave lock timeouts), but each per-suite analysis independently marks "Breaking PR: Unknown." Direct proof — timing correlation between T-GM FREERUN events and OC daemon-restart windows — is absent from available evidence.
3. **Parallel-passed / serial-failed:** `[bc-parallel] PTP Slave Clock Sync` PASSED (93 s) while bc-serial tests failed. This is not a paradox: the parallel test uses `OsClockSyncStateChange` event subscription, not `GetClockIDForeign` log parsing, so it is unaffected by the missing "selected best master clock" log line.

            podman login -u serviceaccount -p ${pass:1:-1} image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 --tls-verify=false
          fi

          export IMG=PTP_IMAGE
          export DAEMON_IMG="DAEMON_IMAGE"
          export SIDECAR_IMG="SIDECAR_IMAGE"

          export USE_UPSTREAM="USE_UPSTREAM_VAL"

            git clone --single-branch --branch main https://github.com/k8snetworkplumbingwg/ptp-operator.git

          sed -i "s/\(CGO_ENABLED=\${CGO_ENABLED}\) \(GOOS=\${GOOS}\)/\1 CC=\"gcc -fuse-ld=gold\" \2/" hack/build.sh

            podman build -t "${IMG}" -f "$DOCKERFILE"

          IMAGE_TAG_BASE="${DAEMON_IMG%:*}" VERSION="${DAEMON_IMG##*:}" make image
          podman push ${DAEMON_IMG} --tls-verify=false
          cd ..

          echo "Running on main branch of cloud-event-proxy"
          git clone --single-branch --branch main https://github.com/redhat-cne/cloud-event-proxy.git
          cd cloud-event-proxy
          IMG=${SIDECAR_IMG} make podman-build
          podman push ${SIDECAR_IMG} --tls-verify=false
          cd ..

      securityContext:
        privileged: true
      volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /var/run/secrets/openshift.io/push
          name: dockercfg
          readOnly: true
        - name: secret-volume

        items:
        - key: .dockerconfigjson
          path: config.json

    - name: dockercfg
      secret:
        secretName: BUILDER_DOCKERCFG
        defaultMode: 384

**TL;DR:** All 6 failures are lab/hardware problems: GNSS loss on T-GM node, T-BC topology undiscoverable, DualNICBCHA log timeout.

**Overall Issue Class:** infra_other
**Overall Severity:** MEDIUM

## Root Causes (6 failures across 1 suites)

### 3/6 failures — T-GM node stuck in FREERUN (no GNSS lock)
- **Suites:** all+dualnicbcha+tbc+tgm | **Evidence:** PROVEN
- **What:** Node `cnfdf32` remained at clockClass 248 (FREERUN) for the entire tgm run (08:27–08:35); all three tgm tests require a GNSS-locked baseline (clockClass ≤ 7). `ptp.go:4061/4157/4185`.
- **Breaking change:** Unknown
- **Flake?** Possible — intermittent GNSS antenna/receiver condition in lab; no historical recurrence data.
- **Fix:** Verify GNSS antenna/receiver on `cnfdf32.telco5gran.eng.rdu2.redhat.com` is physically connected and rerun once clockClass 6/7 is confirmed in ts2phc logs.

### 2/6 failures — T-BC topology not discoverable
- **Suites:** all+dualnicbcha+tbc+tgm | **Evidence:** PROVEN
- **What:** `SynchronizedBeforeSuite` aborted with "no T-BC solution found for TBC" (`ptp.go:367`, `parallel_suite_test.go:59`), cascading to the tbc reboot-discovery test.
- **Breaking change:** Unknown
- **Flake?** No — deterministic topology-discovery failure aborted tbc suite setup entirely.
- **Fix:** Check T-BC node PtpConfig and hardware provisioning in the lab; confirm topology satisfies discovery requirements before rerunning.

### 1/6 failures — DualNICBCHA daemon log read timeout
- **Suites:** all+dualnicbcha+tbc+tgm | **Evidence:** PROVEN
- **What:** `[dualnicbcha-serial]` phc2sys failover test timed out reading linuxptp daemon logs; log subsystem was unresponsive or slow.
- **Breaking change:** Unknown
- **Flake?** Possible — intermittent infra/log-collection slowness.
- **Fix:** Check linuxptp daemon log availability on the DualNICBCHA node; retry if transient.

## Summary Table

| # | Test | Suite | Group | Classification | Confidence | Root Cause (one line) | Fix |
|---|------|-------|-------|---------------|------------|----------------------|-----|
| 1 | WPC T-GM holdover connection loss | tgm-serial | 1 | infra_other | medium | GNSS not locking on cnfdf32 (clockClass 248) | Fix GNSS antenna, rerun |
| 2 | ts2phc termination FREERUN recovery | tgm-serial | 1 | infra_other | medium | GNSS not locking on cnfdf32 (clockClass 248) | Fix GNSS antenna, rerun |
| 3 | T-GM Events GNSS reboot/recovery | tgm-serial | 1 | infra_other | medium | GNSS not locking on cnfdf32 (clockClass 248) | Fix GNSS antenna, rerun |
| 4 | [SynchronizedBeforeSuite] | tbc | 2 | infra_other | medium | No T-BC solution found, suite aborted | Fix T-BC topology config |
| 5 | TBC slave node reboot discovery | tbc-serial | 2 | infra_other | medium | Cascade from SynchronizedBeforeSuite failure | Fix T-BC topology config |
| 6 | DualNICBCHA phc2sys secondary failover | dualnicbcha-serial | 3 | infra_other | medium | Daemon log read timeout | Check log subsystem, retry |

## Action Items
